description: Find Indonesian Constitutional Court (Mahkamah Konstitusi, MK) judicial-review outcomes on statutes — petitions granted (article declared unconstitutional), rejected or inadmissible, plus DPR's post-ruling analyses and its statements in the case — by case number (e.g. 91/PUU-XVIII/2020), by Indonesian statute words, or by year, from the DPR RI "Info Judicial Review" resume collection (800+ documents). Returns the case number, the statute under review, the outcome category and a link for idn_mk_review_detail. Use for "Constitutional Court rulings on the election law", "was the petition against UU 11/2020 granted", "MK decisions in 2023".

category.description: all (default), granted, rejected, analysis, dpr_statement — or a comma-separated subset.

query.description: Case number like "21/PUU-XXI/2023", or Indonesian words from the statute title, e.g. "pemilihan umum", "ketenagakerjaan", "nomor 13 tahun 2003". Optional.

year.description: Four-digit year of the ruling/publication, e.g. "2023". Optional.

name: idn_mk_review_search
title: Idn Mk Review Search
